title: каждый + accusative: Every day, every Wednesday

blocks.text: “Every” in time expressions: каждый день, каждое утро, каждую среду — the accusative.

«The word „every“ in time expressions answering the question „how often“ is rendered as follows: Каждый день (понедельник, вторник, четверг) — masc. (acc.); Каждое утро (воскресенье) — neut. (acc.); Каждую среду (пятницу, субботу) — fem. (acc.)»

DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 22. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
